# DAFZA Shed C-11

> Shed C-11 is a light industrial unit in Dubai Airport Free Zone, the business park that adjoins Dubai International Airport on its eastern side. The free zone's industrial park offers serviced warehouse and light industrial sheds used for regional distribution, assembly and after-sales service by trading and manufacturing companies. Units of this type pair covered storage with attached office accommodation and sit within minutes of the airport's cargo terminals.

## Project Overview

- Category: Hospitality & Landmark Entertainment
- Location: Dubai Airport Freezone, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

Shed C-11 is a light industrial unit in the Dubai Airport Freezone (DAFZA), the free zone adjoining Dubai International Airport. The unit was delivered for Time Force Middle East, which operates from DAFZA as a regional distribution and customer service hub for luxury watch and accessory brands. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the unit, providing its mechanical, electrical and plumbing services.
